# SoFlo UnderPressure

> Pressure washing and soft washing company serving Miami-Dade and Broward County, Florida. Owner-run, licensed and insured. Residential, commercial, and HOA / property-management work. Flat, upfront pricing - no hourly rates.

Contact: (305) 894-6336 · SoFlo.Underpressure@gmail.com
Service area: Miami-Dade County and Broward County, Florida
Hours: Sun - Thu 8am - 8pm, Fri 8am - 3pm

## Services

- [Pressure Washing & Soft Washing (overview)](https://sofloup.com/services.html): Every surface we clean, pricing, and how we match method to material.
- [Soft Washing](https://sofloup.com/services/soft-washing.html): Low-pressure cleaning (~100 PSI) that kills algae at the root. Safe for roofs, stucco, paint, siding, and screens.
- [Roof Soft Washing](https://sofloup.com/services/roof-soft-washing.html): Algae and black-streak removal using the only method roofing manufacturers endorse. From $299.
- [House Soft Washing](https://sofloup.com/services/house-soft-washing.html): Full exterior soft wash for stucco and painted surfaces. From $249.
- [Driveway Pressure Washing](https://sofloup.com/services/driveway-pressure-washing.html): Concrete and paver cleaning with a surface cleaner for even results.
- [Patio & Pool Deck Cleaning](https://sofloup.com/services/patio-pool-deck-cleaning.html): Travertine, natural stone, and pavers cleaned at safe pressure. From $129.
- [Fence Cleaning](https://sofloup.com/services/fence-cleaning.html): Wood, vinyl, aluminum, and chain-link at pressure matched to the material. From $99.
- [Commercial Storefront Cleaning](https://sofloup.com/services/commercial-storefront-cleaning.html): Sidewalks, entryways, and facades cleaned before you open.

## Plans & commercial

- [Recurring Service Plans](https://sofloup.com/membership.html): Scheduled cleaning on a set cadence to keep exteriors ahead of South Florida algae year-round.
- [HOA & Property Managers](https://sofloup.com/hoa-property-managers.html): Multi-unit and community work on one contract, one point of contact.
